The corpus has a function for each.

```json
{"facts": {"dedent": "textwrap.dedent", "clean": "inspect.cleandoc"}}
```

- `textwrap.dedent(text)` removes any common leading whitespace from every line of `text`. It is meant for triple-quoted strings that are indented in the source but should line up with the left edge when displayed.
- `inspect.cleandoc` cleans up docstring indentation. `inspect.getdoc` uses it to clean the documentation string it returns, and `ast.get_docstring` calls it when its `clean` argument is true. The snippets I retrieved did not include the definition of `cleandoc` itself, so its role is confirmed only through those two references.
